summary: Researcher block 2: answered Q1..Q12 with evidence (GUM H.5, GOST R ISO 5725-6 4.1.2/4.1.4/4.2.3/7, RMG61 5.2/5.5/6.5, RMG76 5.13, GOST 34100.3.1 7.9.2/7.9.4/8, 17025 7.6, GUIDE 33 10/11, GOST EN 13132 tabl.1/2, appendix A densities). Fixed methodic decisions R1..R6. Created METHODIC_CONTRACT_ANOVA_GUM.md. Closed U3 (X g/g -> %mass conversion via m_sample; range map; densities from appendix A: MTBE 745.3 kg/m3). Registered TD-DEV-187..193 in PROBLEMS_REGISTER.md (contract 05). Chart findings v4 (requirement 7): profile = U(x)=k*u_c (200 pt), nu_eff/k by GUM G.4, u_c includes etalons - v15 lacks k/etalons/backward-calibration.

answers_Q1_Q12.answer: GUM H.5 (GOST 34100.3-2017) prescribes ANOVA to identify random effects (sigma_r within level, sigma_L between days) and to include them in u_c via hierarchy; H.5.3.3 explicitly: 'ANOVA allows to estimate only SOME components'. For v15 (6 levels x 2 injections, single day, J=1) full two-level balanced hierarchical ANOVA (H.5.2) is NOT reproducible: only intra-level sigma_r (df=6) is estimable. Inter-laboratory sigma_L is taken from tabl.1/2 GOST EN 13132 (sigma_R=R/2.8, sigma_L=sqrt(max(0,sigma_R^2-sigma_r^2))). This is the 'grubiy uchet' boundary (RMG61 5.5, 5725-6 section 7).

answers_Q1_Q12.notes: PLAN_FACTORY_CYCLE.md test 'b' value 0.0357 = r/2.8 is WRONG (registered TD-DEV-193); correct 0.1071/0.1041.

answers_Q1_Q12.answer: Anti-double-count rules: (1) u_model (OLS on means) already contains averaged injection repeatability -> sigma_r is NOT added as separate budget row; (2) sigma_r is used only for sigma_L decomposition (sigma_L=sqrt(sigma_R^2-sigma_r^2)) and for u_repr form sqrt(R^2-r^2/2)/2.8; (3) u_repr enters as sqrt(sigma_R^2-sigma_r^2*(1-1/n)) so local repeatability is subtracted, not duplicated; (4) if sample u(Y0) measured, subtract local repeatability per rule; (5) LoF F-test is adequacy criterion, NOT a budget contribution; (6) etalons and purity are independent; with shared stock - correlation matrix (v15 04_Kovariaciya), not component-wise sum. Final: u_c^2 = u_model^2 + u_etalon^2 + u_purity^2 + u_mass^2 + u_repr^2 (+ u_sample^2 with subtraction rule).

Protocol-correct profile is U(x)=k*u_c(x) (GUM 6.2.1/7.2.4; 17025 7.6.3 note 1: method sets limits and form of representation -> laboratory satisfies; reference v4 uses U=k*u_c). v15 profile is u_c without k -> C4/TD-DEV-24. v16: profile U(x) on 200-point grid + marker x_pred + U at x_pred in report.

Use nu_eff by Welch-Satterthwaite (GUM G.4 formula G.2b): nu_eff = u_c^4 / sum(u_i^4/nu_i). k=t_{0.975}(nu_eff); k=2 (RMG61 6.5.2) is a simplification valid at nu_eff>=30 (GUM 6.3.3). v4 implements nu_eff/k (TINV). With df_regression=4, k is notably >2 (t(4)=2.776, t(6)=2.447).
answers_Q1_Q12.evidence: GOST_34100_3_2017.txt lines 3367-3391 (G.4, G.2b); RMG61 KEY 6.5.2; v4 'Неопределенность'!B10..B13

answers_Q1_Q12.answer: Variance sources: level (systematic calibration, not random effect), injections (sigma_r - estimable, df=6), series (sigma_L intra-lab - NOT estimable from 1 day; needs QC/BUD-17), laboratories (sigma_L inter-lab - from tabl.1/2). Only some components estimable from 6x2 single-day (GUM H.5.3.3).
answers_Q1_Q12.evidence: GOST_34100_3_2017.txt lines 4612-4657; v15 01_Vvod (6 levels x 2 injections, one day)

answers_Q1_Q12.answer: U3 closed. X(g/g)=mA*pA/(mIS*pIS) is analyte/IS mass ratio (NOT %mass in petrol). Conversion: w_MTBE[%mass] = X * (mIS*pIS/m_sample) * 100; inverse X = w% * m_sample/(mIS*pIS)/100. Range map tabl.1 -> X (at m_sample=100 g, mIS~4.0-4.7 g) in METHODIC_CONTRACT section 9.3. IMPORTANT ASSUMPTION: m_sample=100 g is NOT documented in v15 - requires input field 'sample mass' (registered TD-DEV-190). Densities (appendix A): MTBE 745.3 kg/m3, ETBE 745.6, TAME 775.2.
answers_Q1_Q12.notes: m_sample=100 g assumption; density list appendix A

answers_Q1_Q12.answer: Grubiy uchet (tabl.1/2 sigma_R) is admissible when: no inter-lab data of lab, no QC series (single day), LoF not significant, and assumption documented (RMG61 5.5 splitting by ranges; 5725-6 section 7 using method precision for uncertainty; 17025 7.6.3 note 1). Document: contribution list, type A/B, nu_i, nu_eff, k, assumption sigma_R from tabl.1/2.

Inverse calibration X0=(Y0-b)/a; u^2(X0) = [u^2(Y0) + X0^2*u^2(a) + u^2(b) + 2*X0*cov(a,b)]/a^2. Interval form in v4 'Неопределенность'!B2: s^2*(1/p+1/n+(x-xbar)^2/Sxx)/a^2. Sample u(Y0) from replicate injections. Add u_repr per anti-double-count rule.

Full hierarchical ANOVA (GUM H.5.2) impossible (single day). v16 algorithm: sigma_r from replicate injections (df=6); sigma_R from tabl.1/2 (R/2.8); sigma_L=sqrt(max(0,sigma_R^2-sigma_r^2)). REML only with multiple series (needs QC data). Negative variance -> MAX(0,..) per GUM.

MC-verification per GOST 34100.3.1 section 8: adaptive M (7.9.4, M0=max(J,10^4), J=100/(1-p)); delta per 7.9.2 (delta=0.5*10^l with l from ndig); criterion |y_low,GUM-y_low,MC|<=delta and |y_high,GUM-y_high,MC|<=delta; at section 8.2 check use delta/5. Distributions: response ~ N, purity ~ U(99;100), masses ~ U(pm Delta_m/2) or N, etalons ~ N; correlation rho(pA,pIS) modeled. Report Delta (GUM vs MC).

Canonical budget v16: (1) model/calibration, (2) etalons u(x_cal), (3) purity (pA,pIS), (4) masses (scales), (5) sample u(Y0) (for result), (6) u_repr tabl.1/2. EXCLUDE: Recovery/dilution/volume/inhomogeneity (gravimetric method without them - 'bez izlishestv' plan 6.2), sigma_r as separate row (double count), LoF. v4 budget has 7 incl. Recovery/dilution/volume/H - NOT applicable to GOST EN 13132.

methodic_decisions_R1_R6.R2: ANOVA components from 6x2: sigma_r from injections (df=6); sigma_R from tabl.1/2; sigma_L=sqrt(max(0,sigma_R^2-sigma_r^2)); full GUM H.5 not reproducible (single day).
methodic_decisions_R1_R6.R3: Anti-double-count: OLS residual (21% variance) = local repeatability + line components; sigma_r NOT separate row; u_repr=sqrt(R^2-r^2/2)/2.8 subtracts local repeatability; LoF/Recovery/volume/inhomogeneity excluded; u_c^2=u_model^2+u_etalon^2+u_purity^2+u_mass^2+u_repr^2 (+u_sample^2 with subtraction).
methodic_decisions_R1_R6.R4: Profile = U(x)=k*u_c(x) (as v4), 200 points, marker x_pred; NOT u_c as v15.
methodic_decisions_R1_R6.R5: nu_eff by Welch-Satterthwaite (GUM G.2b); df: regression n-2=4, sample replicates p-1, levels sigma_r sum(n_i-1)=6, tabl.1/2 nu=inf (type B). k=t_{0.975}(nu_eff); k=2 at nu_eff>=30.
methodic_decisions_R1_R6.R6: Budget 5+1: model, etalons, purity, masses, sample (for result), u_repr tabl.1/2; exclusions per R3.
